name: Joe's Education Business Plan Rubric
description: 24-criterion evaluation rubric for 2Hr Learning / Alpha education business units, derived from Joe's Business Plan One-Pager

criteria.question: Does the plan unlock potential for EVERY kid — not just a select few?
Will kids love this school / experience? Is joy and engagement central?
Does it embody High Standards / High Support — rigorous academics with strong pastoral care?
Does the plan target >2x learning pace (measured via MAP or equivalent standardized testing)?
Are there 3rd-party benchmarks for life skills development (creativity, leadership, resilience)?
Does the plan benchmark against the best schools globally, not just local averages?
Is there a product range spanning $150K/yr (premium) down to $1K/yr (broad access)?
Are lower-price tiers used as sampling / funnel for higher-value offerings?
Is the product quality genuinely world-class at each price point?
Is the go-to-market strategy direct-to-parent (not reliant on school district sales)?
Is there a community flywheel — parents referring parents, student word-of-mouth?
Does the marketing spend threshold tie to proven academic results (e.g., MAP scores)?
Are there AI-powered feedback loops that maintain quality as enrollment scales?
Does the model have flywheel / network effects (more students = better product)?
Can the platform reach 100K+ students without proportional cost increase?
Does the plan demonstrate high ROIC (return on invested capital)?
Is there best-in-class customer retention (>90% annual)?
Is the model asset-light (minimal capital expenditure per student)?
Is there a scalable talent pipeline for guides/teachers at target student volumes?
Does the compensation model attract top educators while maintaining unit economics?
Is there an AI-augmented coaching model that amplifies human talent?
Does the plan leverage government funding (ESA, vouchers, charter grants) for broad access?
Is there a clear path from premium pricing to subsidized/free access for underserved families?
Does the plan address regulatory requirements for funding eligibility?

output_format.category_scores: Score per category with justification and evidence
